name: Support
overview: Scripture reveals that support encompasses both practical and spiritual dimensions, urging believers to uphold the weak through active labor and encouragement, as taught in Acts 20:35. The strength found in unity is likened to a threefold cord that is not quickly broken (Ecclesiastes 4:12), highlighting the power of mutual support. Confidence in God's sustaining work within believers (Philippians 1:6) and the call to restore those who stray from the truth (James 5:19) further emphasize the ongoing spiritual support necessary within the body of Christ. This support extends beyond physical needs to include moral and spiritual encouragement grounded in Christ's example and promise.
